items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: He worked with a drummer by the name of Banks. Did you meet him with a drummer? Nah, he didn't ever have a band. I guess he did have a band later. I guess he did. ... Well, he did most of his work though with this fellow Banks, because Banks had the band, the drummer.

ctx.x: Yes. Talking about Albert Emmons, uh... When did you meet him first? Did you meet him in the 20s or later?

Oh, I met him in the 30s. In the 30s. Oh, yeah. Yeah. I met Albert... must have been around 34, 35. And he also had a band. Yeah. No, he was with Banks. He worked with a drummer by the name of Banks. Did you meet him with a drummer? Nah, he didn't ever have a band. I guess he did have a band later. I guess he did.
Yes, he once recorded with a band, Guy Kelly.
